command: Build and install the phase 0.58 core, Prefect, SQL, SQLModel, FastAPI, and test backend wheels in a fresh Python 3.11 environment. With PYTHONPATH unset: python -m pytest -o pythonpath= -q tests/prefect -m prefect.
result: The installed-wheel live Prefect/PostgreSQL suite passed: 41 passed in 49.72s with no skips. Installed-wheel headless/FastAPI route parity passed: 1 passed in 0.53s.
assertions: A durable CSV-to-PostgreSQL submission is dispatched to a real Process worker. The test pauses after the sink effect and successful ETL report are durable but before the execution host finalizes the attempt and publication.

The separately supervised Prefect API is stopped while the worker is held. An authorized status read preserves canonical ETL status and reports the remote orchestration observation and reconciliation relation as unavailable; it does not rewrite canonical state.

The Prefect API restarts against the same PostgreSQL database before the worker is released. The worker finalizes the existing attempt, publishes the report, and the canonical submission completes without a second sink effect.
Post-run PostgreSQL checks confirm one target row, one effect-ledger record, one completed attempt, and the successful canonical report.

runtime.prefect_server: Separately supervised self-hosted API process backed by PostgreSQL; stopped and restarted against the same database at a pending-publication boundary
runtime.worker_backend_plugin: Separately built and installed etlantic-phase058-test-worker-plugin 0.1.0 wheel

source_sha256_method: SHA-256 over sorted repository-relative source paths and file bytes, with NUL separators.
limitations: This trace covers one API restart at the post-effect, pre-host-finalization boundary. It does not cover a prolonged API outage, simultaneous dispatcher and worker death, or API loss during connector I/O.
This is local installed-wheel evidence for CPython 3.11.15, Prefect 3.7.8, PostgreSQL 16.13, and Process workers only; remote CI and the full supported-version/hosting matrix remain open.

ci_configuration.database_service: Local PostgreSQL 16.13; test tables and per-test Prefect database were cleaned.
ci_configuration.server_process: Separate Prefect API process with PostgreSQL persistence

cleanup: The test used unique tenant, workspace, submission, deployment, sink-table, effect-ledger, and Prefect database identities.
The Prefect API process stopped and its dedicated database was dropped after the test; the shared PostgreSQL service and temporary installed-wheel environment remain available.
